## What Federal Reserve interest rates are signaling in 2026

At its September 16 meeting, the Federal Open Market Committee raised the federal funds target range by 0.25 percentage point to 3.75%–4.00%. Investors largely expected the increase, which marked the first Federal Reserve rate hike in more than three years. Rising energy costs and persistent inflation complicate the outlook. Investors now anticipate three additional hikes by mid-2027, including one more in 2026.
